exposure: Apgar scores at the first minute
Need for endotracheal intubation at birth
cohort: Newborns admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) between 2005 and 2015 with a diagnosis of MAS (0.66% of all NICU admissions).
finding: Nonreassuring or abnormal CTG and low Apgar score at the first minute were identified as risk factors for MAS, and need for surfactant therapy was a predictor of severity.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was more prevalent in newborns diagnosed with MAS (p < .001).
